visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long wavy brown hair and a tan shirt holds two spherical toy containers titled 'Mini Verse' towards the camera in a bright indoor setting. (2) The camera zooms in on one of the balls, showing detailed graphics of cocktails and the text 'Make It Mini Happy Hour'. (3) The woman points her finger at a '21+ Adults Only' warning label on the packaging while looking surprised. (4) Her hands vigorously tear the plastic wrapping off the ball, revealing the multi-layered contents inside. (5) She unfolds a large instruction sheet displaying various miniature cocktail recipes with illustrations. (6) A close-up shows her holding a tiny translucent cocktail shaker and a small pink accessory. (7) She presents a miniature blue and white bottle of 'Roma' liquid to the camera. (8) Tiny orange slices and a small rose-gold colored ice bucket are held up for inspection. (9) She carefully pours clear orange liquid from the tiny bottle into a miniature clear glass. (10) Small plastic ice cubes are dropped into the liquid inside the tiny glass. (11) The woman holds a tiny orange slice and uses full-sized metal scissors to snip a small notch into the edge of the miniature fruit. (12) She displays two completed miniature cocktails, one with a straw and orange slice, while smiling. (13) The camera shows a top-down view of the completed set: two drinks, a shaker, and an ice bucket on a small white tray on a wooden table. (14) A man in a brown and white patterned shirt speaks animatedly to the camera in a living room, while a young child sits in the foreground holding a piece of paper; the man then runs away waving his hands as if chasing something.
